tools_used: rate limit: >= 2s between requests, mostly via explicit `sleep 2`

robots_txt.interpretation: Everything under /strategies/ is allowed. /api/ is explicitly disallowed; the site's own client-side pagination and search widgets call /api/ under the hood, so we did not call /api/ directly and did not drive a JS browser to trigger it indirectly either.

terms_and_pricing.api_or_dataset_download: No public/free API and no bulk dataset download found. robots.txt names an /api/ path that backs the site's own UI (search box, pagination beyond page 1); it is not documented or offered as a public API and is covered by Disallow. A 'research agent' (in-browser sandbox) and an MCP connector exist, but both are paid-plan features that operate on the account holder's own unlocked strategies, not a bulk export.
terms_and_pricing.no_login_no_paywall_bypass: We did not create an account, log in, or attempt to unlock any paid strategy/code/dataset. Everything recorded here is what the site serves to an anonymous, unauthenticated request.

catalog_enumeration.claimed_catalog_size: ~5,000 (site copy: 'Search 5,000 peer-reviewed trading strategies' and pricing page: '5,000+ strategies with runnable Python'); sitemap has 5,341 individual /strategies/<slug> URLs, consistent with that claim
catalog_enumeration.pagination_finding: The default listing at /strategies is fully server-rendered (50 real strategy cards with Sharpe/period/asset-class/rebalancing chips embedded in the initial HTML). /strategies/page/2 .. /strategies/page/88 (the deepest page number the pagination widget names) return HTTP 200 but an EMPTY shell (~112KB, only nav/footer, zero strategy cards) -- confirmed by fetching page 2 twice (byte-identical, 111689 bytes both times) and page 88. The path-based pager depends on client-side JavaScript, almost certainly calling the /api/ route robots.txt disallows, so we did not paginate through it and did not drive a headless browser to do so either (that would just relocate the same disallowed call into a browser process). A bare query-string variant (/strategies?page=2) 308-redirects away rather than paginating.
catalog_enumeration.search_workaround: The full-text search box (/strategies?q=<term>) IS server-rendered (confirmed: returns up to 50 real cards with full stats, e.g. ?q=momentum). This path is under /strategies, not /api/, so it is allowed by robots.txt. We used it as a policy-compliant way to sample far beyond the 50 cards on page 1.
catalog_enumeration.query_list_note: 1 default listing (/strategies) + 102 distinct ?q= keyword searches across four rounds (finance/factor vocabulary, asset classes, rebalancing styles, sector/commodity themes); see reports/research/harvest/search-log.jsonl entry search:20260923:pwb:catalog for the query themes
catalog_enumeration.diminishing_returns_observed: round 1 (30 queries): 38 strategies qualified for the shortlist filter; round 2 (+30 queries, cumulative 60): 44 qualified; round 3 (+25, cumulative 85): 46 qualified; round 4 (+15, cumulative 100): 47 qualified. Marginal yield per query batch fell from ~1.5 new qualifiers/query to ~0.1, so we stopped rather than exhaustively searching the remaining ~3,000 unseen slugs.
what_could_not_be_reached: The remaining ~56% of the 5,341-strategy catalog beyond our 2,335-card keyword-search sample: full pagination is blocked (see pagination_finding above); reaching every strategy would require either the disallowed /api/ or opening all 5,341 individual detail pages one at a time, which is far beyond the 'up to 60 detail pages' this task calls for.

Runnable Python code for any strategy: never shown on a public strategy page in our sample; it is a paid-plan unlock ('5,000+ strategies with runnable Python' is explicitly a Backtester-tier line item). We did not attempt to unlock it.

Per-year (or per-month) numeric return breakdowns on detail pages: each detail page shows a 'Net worth' chart with 1Y/3Y/5Y/10Y/Max view toggles, but the chart's underlying data points are not present as static text or embedded JSON in the server-rendered HTML (likely fetched client-side); we recorded 'not shown as static text' rather than reading values off a chart we cannot render, and rather than reverse-engineering the chart's client-side data source.
Exact per-page 'current positions' counts for a few strategies whose detail page does not render a positions table at all (shown as null in catalog/shortlist data, not a parsing failure).

rate_limiting.policy: minimum 2 seconds between requests, enforced with `sleep 2` before every request after the first handful of exploratory fetches
rate_limiting.total_requests_this_session: ~158 (1 robots.txt, 1 sitemap.xml, 1 terms, 1 pricing, ~6 exploratory listing/pagination probes, 102 search-query listing fetches, 47 strategy detail-page fetches)
rate_limiting.blocked_or_throttled: none observed: every request returned HTTP 200 (one 308 redirect on an unsupported query-string pagination guess, not a block)
